# Bangladesh OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **10 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Bangladesh ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Bangladesh national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Bangladesh public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Bangladesh in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 13,550,000 |
| Lines / route length | 41 / 1,157 km |
| Fleet | 1,901 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $10.93 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $8.21 B (75%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 158.0 MW / 851.5 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $16.95 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
